digest.component_or_area: Store write lock acquisition and retry mechanism
propositions: A write whose lock acquire() times out is permanently discarded with no retry, making the loss terminal and non-recoverable
The acquire() method computes a single shared deadline from timeout*attempts rather than implementing a retry loop, treating attempts as a silent multiplier
Both fcntl and mkdir lock legs poll non-blocking with jitter, offering no fairness and making contention lottery-based when holders exceed the budget
Holder duration exceeding the 60s budget causes all waiters to fail simultaneously regardless of service order, making FIFO fairness ineffective
A write body never executes when acquire() times out, making bounded retry-with-backoff safe because re-attempts cannot double-append or replay writes
The retry is implemented as discrete passes with backoff and warnings, providing a ~181.5s total ceiling (3 passes × 60s + backoff) to convert loss into latency
